sn54.5:1.1: ānāpānasati bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
sn54.5:1.2: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave, ānāpānasati kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā:
sn54.5:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā
sn54.5:1.6: evaṃ bhāvitā kho bhikkhave, ānāpānasati evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
sn54.5:2.1: evaṃ bhāvitāya kho bhikkhave, ānāpānasatiyā evaṃ bahulīkatāya sattaphalā sattānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.
sn54.5:2.4: no ce diṭṭhevadhamme paṭigacca aññaṃ ārādheti.
sn54.5:2.6: no ce diṭṭhevadhamme paṭigacca aññaṃ ārādheti. no ce maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti.
sn54.5:2.7: atha pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarā parinibbāyī hoti.
sn54.5:2.12: evaṃ bhāvitāya kho bhikkhave, ānāpānasatiyā evaṃ bahulīkatāya ime sattaphalā sattānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhāti.
